texts: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence.
Natural language processing helps computers understand human language.
Deep learning uses neural networks with multiple layers.
Transformers are powerful models for sequence processing.
Attention mechanisms help models focus on relevant information.
Tokenization breaks text into smaller units for processing.
Embeddings represent words as dense vectors.
Fine-tuning adapts pre-trained models to specific tasks.
Evaluation metrics measure model performance accurately.
